author: Glenn Marini
title: Saint Francis knocks off no. 19 Huntington - NewsBreak
text:
By Glenn Marini ,
1 hours ago
HUNTINGTON, Ind. (WANE) – Marr Avance and Karson Rogers tallied 17 points apiece to lead visiting Saint Francis to a 62-61 win over 19th-ranked Huntington University at Platt Arena on Wednesday night.
Rogers added 16 rebounds, while Woodlan High School graduate Joe Reidy chipped in with 8 points and 9 boards.
Huntington was led by Kaden Johnson’s 17 points and 14 rebounds, while Cade Brenner added 12 points and Jackson Paul 11 points and a game-high 7 assists.
USF improves to 11-15 overall and 6-11 in Crossroads League play, while Huntington drops to 20-7 overall and 11-6 in conference.
